summary: This is an SSH configuration block that sets up connection details for a host named 'my_app'. When you SSH to 'my_app', it will automatically use the specified hostname, username, and private key file instead of requiring you to type them each time.

explanations.1: This creates a named host alias called 'my_app' that you can reference in SSH commands instead of typing the full hostname.
explanations.2: This tells SSH the actual server address to connect to when you reference 'my_app'.
explanations.4: This specifies which private key file to use for authentication — SSH will try this specific key instead of the default ones.
